fence_surface_input_groups.description: Same single-item model as NC. PaintScope delivers final SF after (LF x Height x 2) and fence_style multiplier. Gate hardware count for masking tasks. Protection inputs LF or SF based.

task_production_rates.name: Landscape Protection Along Fence Base (Both Sides)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Reused from NC. Deploy drop cloths/plastic along fence base both sides. ~29 sec/LF.

defect_tolerance.all: Full coverage both sides. Tarps secured against wind.

task_production_rates.name: Hardscape Protection Along Fence Line
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Reused from NC. Canvas drop cloths on walkways/driveways. ~36 sec/LF.

defect_tolerance.all: Full coverage of hardscape within 4 ft of fence line.

task_production_rates.name: Siding Protection at Fence-to-House Junction
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Reused from NC. Tape and plastic at junction. ~60 sec/SF.

defect_tolerance.all: Full seal at junction. No gaps for overspray.

task_production_rates.name: Vehicle Overspray Protection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Reused from NC. Full plastic cover on vehicle. ~15 min/vehicle.

defect_tolerance.all: Complete coverage. No exposed panels facing fence.

task_production_rates.name: Neighbor Property Line Protection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Reused from NC. Drop cloth along neighbor side. ~36 sec/LF.

defect_tolerance.all: Full coverage along neighbor property. Coordination with neighbor.

task_production_rates.name: Gate Hardware Removal and Masking
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Reused from NC. Remove/mask gate latches and hinges. ~10 min/gate.

defect_tolerance.all: All hardware protected or removed. Gate operational after reinstall.

task_production_rates.name: Identify Existing Coating Type
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. Fixed-time assessment. Water drop test, visual inspection, scratch test. Identify penetrating stain vs solid stain vs paint. ~20 min per project.

defect_tolerance.all: Correct coating identification documented.

task_production_rates.name: Coating Adhesion Test
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. Cross-hatch adhesion test on film-forming coatings. 3-5 test spots across fence. ~15 min.

defect_tolerance.all: Adhesion results documented for each test spot.

task_production_rates.name: Wood Moisture Content Test
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Pin-type moisture meter. 5-8 test points across fence. MC <=19% (<=25% PT). ~15 min.

defect_tolerance.all: MC at or below threshold for all test points.

task_production_rates.name: Post Base Rot Assessment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. Probe post bases at grade line. Pick test for softness. ~20 min for typical fence (8-15 posts).

defect_tolerance.all: All posts assessed. Rotted posts documented and flagged as hard stop.

task_production_rates.name: Mildew and Algae Assessment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Visual inspection both sides. ~10 min.

defect_tolerance.all: Mildew areas marked for treatment.

task_production_rates.name: Pressure Wash Fence (1000-1500 PSI)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Reused from NC with RP adjustment. Power wash both sides. ~9 sec/SF. RP surfaces may have more residue — slightly slower than NC.

defect_tolerance.all: All surfaces cleaned. No mud, dirt, loose debris, or mildew remaining.

task_production_rates.name: Mildew Eradication Treatment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Reused from NC. Apply mildewcide, dwell 10 min, rinse. ~18 sec/SF applied area.

defect_tolerance.all: No visible mildew after treatment and rinse.

task_production_rates.name: Scrape Loose/Failing Coating
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. Scrape peeling/failing paint or solid stain. ~60 sec/SF of affected area. Condition modifier applies (POOR = 2x, heavy peeling).

defect_tolerance.all: All loose coating removed. No lifting edges remaining.

task_production_rates.name: Feather-Edge Sand Scraped Areas
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. 80-grit feather-edge sanding at coating transitions. ~72 sec/SF. MANDATORY after scraping.

defect_tolerance.all: Smooth transition from coating to bare wood. No sharp edges.

task_production_rates.name: Light Scuff Sand for Adhesion
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP-NEW. 100-grit scuff sand on sound solid stain/paint. ~24 sec/SF. Light pass for adhesion profile.

defect_tolerance.all: Uniform scuff pattern. No gloss remaining on solid stain/paint surface.

task_production_rates.name: Post-Prep Dust and Debris Cleanup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Blow off sanding dust and debris. ~6 sec/SF. Leaf blower or compressed air.

defect_tolerance.all: No visible dust or debris on surface before coating.

task_production_rates.name: Apply Alkaline Wood Stripper
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Reused from NC. Pump sprayer application of alkaline stripper. Both sides. ~14 sec/SF.

defect_tolerance.all: Full saturation. No dry spots.

task_production_rates.name: Stripper Dwell Time (15-20 min)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Reused from NC. Wait for stripper to work. Fixed 20 min dwell.

defect_tolerance.all: Stripper not allowed to dry on surface.

task_production_rates.name: Scrub Weathered Surface
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Reused from NC. Stiff bristle brush scrub. ~45 sec/SF.

defect_tolerance.all: Gray fibers and coating residue removed. Fresh wood visible.

task_production_rates.name: Rinse Stripper Residue
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Reused from NC. Pressure washer rinse at 1000 PSI. ~9 sec/SF.

defect_tolerance.all: No chemical residue remaining.

task_production_rates.name: Apply Wood Brightener (Oxalic/Citric Acid)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Reused from NC. Pump sprayer application. ~14 sec/SF.

defect_tolerance.all: Full coverage. Wood visibly brightening.

task_production_rates.name: Brightener Dwell Time (10-15 min)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Reused from NC. Wait for brightener to neutralize. Fixed 15 min dwell.

defect_tolerance.all: Wood noticeably lighter than before brightener.

task_production_rates.name: Rinse Brightener and Final Wash
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Reused from NC. Final rinse at 1000 PSI. ~9 sec/SF.

defect_tolerance.all: Clean, brightened wood. No chemical residue.

task_production_rates.name: Verify Dry Time (12-24 hr) and MC Retest
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Reused from NC. Return next day, MC retest, verify surface ready. ~15 min assessment.

defect_tolerance.all: MC at threshold. Surface dry to touch. No tacky spots.

task_production_rates.name: Prime — Spray with Back-Brush
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Spray primer with back-brush on bare/prepped areas. 2-person crew. ~18 sec/SF. Rate reflects spot or full prime depending on exposure extent.

defect_tolerance.all: Full coverage on all bare wood. No holidays. Back-brush fully worked in.

task_production_rates.name: Prime — Brush Application
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush prime bare/prepped areas. 1-person crew. ~36 sec/SF.

defect_tolerance.all: Full coverage on all bare wood. Even film.

task_production_rates.name: Apply Stain Coat 1 — Spray with Back-Brush
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Reused from NC. 2-person crew: one sprays, one back-brushes. Both sides. ~17 sec/SF. Back-brushing MANDATORY for penetrating stains.

defect_tolerance.all: Even coverage. No pooling at board joints. Back-brush worked into grain.

task_production_rates.name: Apply Stain Coat 1 — Brush
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Reused from NC. Brush stain application. 1-person crew. Both sides. ~30 sec/SF.

defect_tolerance.all: Even coverage. No drips. Thin coat — no excess product.

task_production_rates.name: Apply Paint Coat 1 — Spray with Back-Brush
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Reused from NC. Paint spray with back-brush. 2-person crew. ~12 sec/SF. Faster than stain (film-forming, no penetration concern).

defect_tolerance.all: Even film. No sags, runs, or holidays.

task_production_rates.name: Apply Paint Coat 1 — Brush
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Reused from NC. Brush paint application. 1-person crew. ~26 sec/SF.

defect_tolerance.all: Even film. No drips, sags, or holidays.

task_production_rates.name: Apply Stain Coat 2 — Spray with Back-Brush
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Coat 2 slightly faster than coat 1 — surface sealed from coat 1. ~16 sec/SF. 2-person crew.

defect_tolerance.all: Uniform color. Full coverage. No holidays.

task_production_rates.name: Apply Stain Coat 2 — Brush
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Coat 2 brush. Slightly faster than coat 1. ~28 sec/SF.

defect_tolerance.all: Uniform color. Full coverage.

task_production_rates.name: Apply Paint Coat 2 — Spray with Back-Brush
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Coat 2 paint spray. Slightly faster than coat 1 — sealed surface. ~11 sec/SF.

defect_tolerance.all: Even film. Full hide. No sags.

task_production_rates.name: Apply Paint Coat 2 — Brush
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Coat 2 brush paint. Slightly faster than coat 1. ~24 sec/SF.

defect_tolerance.all: Even film. Full hide.

task_production_rates.name: Final Walkthrough Inspection
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Walk both sides. Check coverage, holidays, drips. ~20 min per project.

defect_tolerance.all: All defects identified and documented.

task_production_rates.name: Touch-Up Defects
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Brush touch-up of defects found during inspection. ~15 min allowance.

defect_tolerance.all: All defects corrected. Touch-ups blend with surrounding area.

task_production_rates.name: Gate Hardware Reinstallation
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Reinstall gate hardware. Verify operation. ~10 min/gate.

defect_tolerance.all: All hardware reinstalled. Gates operate smoothly.

task_production_rates.name: Protection Teardown and Disposal
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Remove all protection from both sides. Dispose of single-use materials. ~30 min.

defect_tolerance.all: All protection removed. No debris left on site.

task_production_rates.name: Equipment and Tool Cleanup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Clean sprayer, brushes, pump sprayer. Pack equipment. ~20 min.

defect_tolerance.all: All tools cleaned and packed. No equipment left on site.

factor_modifiers.name: Condition Scale Prep Modifier
factor_modifiers.notes: Prep tasks only. GOOD = minimal effort, FAIR = moderate wear, POOR = significant failure.

factor_modifiers.name: EPA Lead-Safe RRP Modifier
factor_modifiers.notes: Prep tasks involving paint disturbance only. Wet scraping, HEPA vacuum, containment maintenance.

factor_modifiers.name: Coating Type Application Modifier
factor_modifiers.notes: Application tasks only. Semi-transparent is baseline. Transparent is faster (less pigment). Film-forming coatings slower (more precise application).

factor_modifiers.name: Substrate Type Modifier
factor_modifiers.applies_to_tasks: All prep and application tasks (see individual task factor_modifiers arrays)
factor_modifiers.notes: Cedar is softer, absorbs more product. Applies to both prep and application.

prep_pool.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (FAC_FERP_CONDITION x FAC_FERP_RRP x FAC_FERP_SUBSTRATE_TYPE)
prep_pool.notes: Extreme scenario — pre-1978 cedar fence with severe peeling.

fixed_tasks.notes: Assessment, dwell times, final inspect, teardown, tool cleanup.

rate_summary.prep_stack_note: 4.40x exceeds 4.0x cap in extreme RRP scenario. This is acceptable for pre-1978 lead paint on cedar — recommend T&M billing for this scenario.
